rotation_note: Unattended-run override: NO rotating subset. All 3 core keywords plus the entire politics pool (34 keywords, grouped into policy_regulation / elections_public_opinion / geopolitics) are working keywords today (37 total). Day-of-year 328 sets ORDER only: group lead rotates so no group leads twice in a row (policy_regulation led 11-22, elections_public_opinion led 11-23, so geopolitics leads today, then policy_regulation, then elections_public_opinion); within each group the list starts at offset 328 % group_size in pool order (geopolitics 328 % 10 = 8: AI 패권 first; policy 328 % 15 = 13: AI 저작권 first; elections 328 % 9 = 4: content provenance C2PA first). Queries were not checked with WebSearch (budget reserved for librarians); librarians should prefer outlet RSS/sitemap_news feeds and agency press pages (whitehouse.gov, bis.gov, federalregister.gov, justice.gov, korea.kr, pipc.go.kr, digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu) over site: search for recency. Window: last brief was 2026-11-23, so items published 11-23 (after the prior harvest) through 11-24 are in scope. Context: Tuesday 11-24 in Korea / Monday 11-23 in the US and EU at harvest time. Monday is a full US/EU business day — expect agency releases, Federal Register notices, court filings and state AG actions dated 11-23; Thanksgiving is Thursday 11-26, so US agencies often push releases Monday-Wednesday. Korea: Tuesday 국무회의 (cabinet) agenda can carry AI 시행령/법률 공포안 — check korea.kr 국무회의 results; 국회 과방위/법안소위 and 예결위 run late November. Taiwan local elections are Saturday 11-28: CEC/MJIB/MODA/NSB official counts, indictments or takedown orders on AI deepfakes in the final week are high-value, but the Puma Shen indictment (11-22), the ~2,700 Threads accounts (11-21) and the CIB 219-case count (11-13) are covered — only NEW cases/counts/orders qualify. Hooks — only official documents/actions are new, skip previews and reactions: Trump 'tremendous tax' on offshore AI data centers (only a written EO/Treasury/USTR action/fact sheet/bill text is new); Trump–Xi–Putin summit (only a written joint statement or fact sheet on AI is new); House China Select/Homeland report on Chinese open-weight models (only subpoena/bill/BIS action/company formal response); Hickenlooper Senate AI select committee idea (covered 11-23; only a formal resolution text, caucus rules decision, or bill is new); 14 EU states' AI copyright note (covered 11-23; only a Commission legislative proposal, Council conclusions, or AI Office template revision is new); McGill deepfaked-influencer network (covered 11-23; only a government/regulator action or a new platform takedown report is new); Korea AIDC 특별법 시행령 입법예고 (covered 11-23; the 12-9 public hearing and final promulgation are later — skip restatements); Nvidia California AG subpoena (Huang testimony Dec 1 — skip previews). In scope: bills introduced/marked up, agency rules/bulletins, court rulings and filings, regulator enforcement, export-control actions, official after-action reports on AI-enabled interference, platform takedown reports. OUT of scope: who won, seat counts, polling, horse-race analysis (incl. the Schumer/Van Hollen leadership race), commentary without a new document. Neutrality rule from sources.json applies: report decisions/filings/releases, attribute contested claims, no partisan framing.
